input: One media file of the medium to test and the most readers allowed. It only reads (on Windows past the system file cache).
output: How many readers to run and the rate read at each level tried. It writes nothing and runs no worker.
specification: User 2026-10-18: one short test of the reading speed of the medium decides the number of readers; after that no more testing. Small blocks spread through the file, as a pass reads, with 1, 2, 4 and 8 readers for 0.3 s each; the fewest readers within 5 % of the best.
